_comment: Auto-tunable SIGNAL/INDICATOR parameters only, per strategy. Seeded from config.py's hardcoded defaults. bot/auto_tune.py is the only writer of this file (see bot/auto_tune.py and README 'Automated parameter tuning'); each strategy class loads from here at __init__ and falls back to its config.py default on any missing/corrupt/missing-key condition. Risk sizing, the correlation filter, hard-stop-never-widens logic, and the max-drawdown circuit breaker are NEVER stored here and NEVER touched by the tuner -- those stay hardcoded in risk_manager.py / config.py (RISK_PARAMS, MAX_DRAWDOWN_PCT).
